item.description:
## 0.1.15
- 改进：黑猫、深色毛的猫晚上也看得清（柔和的蓝灰底色和一圈冷色细边，眼睛保留高光）/ Improved: black and dark-coated cats are now easy to see at night (a soft blue-grey base and a thin cool outline; eyes keep their shine) - 改进：小屋里的宠物猫动作和走动更流畅，计算快了约 4 倍，行为不变 / Improved: pet cats move and walk more smoothly; planning is about 4x faster with the same behaviour - 修复：设备状态不再过期——刷新会重新读取开关状态，读取失败的设备会自己恢复，切换地区或退出登录后不再残留旧错误 / Fix: device states no longer go stale: Refresh re-reads on/off states, devices whose first read failed recover on their own, and changing region or signing out clears old errors - 修复：实时画面切换摄像头时不再残留多余的 go2rtc 进程；被其他摄像头顶掉的画面显示为暂停，可点重试 / Fix: switching cameras in Live view no longer leaves an extra go2rtc process running; a stream bumped by another camera shows as paused with Retry - 修复：命令行 `mijiabar --version` 显示真实版本号，`setup-prompt` 显示真实 App 路径，`set` 传入超大数值不再崩溃 / Fix: `mijiabar --version` reports the real app version, `setup-prompt` prints the real app path, and `set` with a huge number no longer crashes - 改进：搜索或排序时自动收起小屋预览；设置 → 设备新增「在设备列表上方显示小屋」开关；小屋动画更顺滑，并补充了无障碍标签 / Improved: the house preview hides while searching or reordering; new Settings → Devices toggle "Show the house above the device list"; smoother house animations and new accessibility labels
